name: batch_baseline
description: Run N independent whole-cell E. coli lineages across seeds and generations — v2ecoli's port of vEcoli's lineage workflow. Each of n_seeds seeds runs an n_generations-generation lineage in its own Ray worker process (safe sequential fallback when Ray is absent), emitting into one shared hive-partitioned parquet sweep plus a per-lineage xarray-zarr store. A post-simulation flush then runs the ported Analyses at every scale the batch covers (single, multigeneration, multiseed, multivariant) along with the Visualizations and report cards, placing each output in the owning study's report dir.

n_seeds.description: Number of independent seeds (vEcoli's n_init_sims); each runs in its own worker process.

n_generations.description: Cell-division generations to follow per seed lineage (vEcoli's generations).

base_seed.description: First RNG seed (vEcoli's lineage_seed); seeds are base_seed .. base_seed+n_seeds-1.

single_daughters.description: Follow ONE daughter per division (vEcoli's default). Off = binary-tree lineage, which also enables the multidaughter analyses.

max_duration.description: Per-generation sim-time cap in seconds (vEcoli's max_duration). A division ends a generation sooner; this only bounds a non-dividing run.

variants.description: vEcoli-style variant grid ({name: {target, value}}); crossed with the seed range. Non-empty also enables the multivariant analyses.

cache_dir.description: Path to the ParCa cache directory (read per seed at run).

out_dir.description: Output root for the parquet sweep, the per-lineage zarr stores and the analysis outputs. Empty = this run's own directory when launched from the workbench (so its Visualizations tab finds the sweep and runs don't overwrite each other), else out/batch_baseline.

experiment_id.description: Experiment id stamped into the parquet partitions and the zarr store names.

emitter.description: Observation sink per lineage: 'parquet' (what the analyses read), 'xarray' (zarr store, what the dashboard's per-run charts read), or 'both'.

analyses.description: 'applicable' runs every ported analysis at the scales this batch covers (single always; multigeneration when n_generations>1; multiseed when n_seeds>1; multidaughter/multivariant likewise). 'none' skips analyses; visualizations and report cards still run.

study.description: Owning study slug for the flush's outputs. Empty = infer from out_dir (a studies/<slug>/ segment).

parallel.description: 'ray' to fan out across worker processes; '' for sequential.

batch_runner.doc: One-shot Step that dispatches the seeds × generations batch (see module).
